subject: Allotment of Securities
detail: Ather Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 2,27,882 equity shares of face value of INR 1/- each to eligible ESOP holders who have exercised their stock options under Ather Energy ESOP 2025 Plan.

subject: Options to purchase securities
detail: Ather Energy Limited has informed the Exchange that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board of Directors of Ather Energy Limited has approved the grant of 4,031 Employee Stock Options (ESOPs) under Ather Energy ESOP 2025 to the eligible employees of the Company on November 17, 2026.
